vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Aroha was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Synnøve taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Synnøve showed Kai the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Nadine showed Otto the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Kai showed Tashi the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Synnøve showed Chloe the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Synnøve drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🛡️ Lily, Nadine, Aroha and Tashi met them at the door — 4 put down. Lily, Nadine, Aroha, Tashi are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

Chloe: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
🛡️ Kai, Otto, Synnøve, Nadine and Aroha met them at the door — 5 put down. Kai, Otto, Synnøve, Nadine, Aroha are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.

Kai strikes the Elder Static.
The Elder Static falls.
📺 Lily, Kai brought down Elder Static. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lily just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kai, Lily, Synnøve, Nadine and Aroha met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kai, Lily, Synnøve, Nadine are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Old Croaker (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Lily, Kai. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Lily strikes the Pack-leader Old Croaker.
The Pack-leader Old Croaker falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Old Croaker!
📺 Lily, Kai brought down Pack-leader Old Croaker, Old Croaker (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Lily, Kai brought down Pack-leader Old Croaker, Old Croaker (packmate). Together.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Otto, Nadine, Aroha, Mara and Henry met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Otto, Nadine, Aroha, Mara, Henry are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
